AI review

1. `bin/greet.sh`: `greet.sh ada --shout` prints hello ada: the flag after the name is ignored without a word.
2. `bin/greet.sh:8`: use `printf` instead of `echo` for the line, as the rest of the script does.
3. `bin/greet.sh:8`: `tr a-z A-Z` misses non-ASCII letters.
1. As specified: --shout goes before the name. 2. Will change. 3. Names are ASCII here.
What happens with `greet.sh --shout` and no name? Please check it greets the world in capitals.
It does: name falls back to world after the shift.
